messages:
elaine: RCA for the 2024-05-18 serving ramp incident is posted: https://confluence.redwood.local/display/RCAs/2024-05-18-Serving-Ramp  

sam: thanks — reading now. huge props to oncall for the fast mitigation :clap:

miguel: high-level recap from the doc: autoscaler misconfigured for short-burst traffic -> risk of queue buildup -> cascading retries. mitigation was an emergency cap + temporary throttling.

tara: adding quick action items from the RCA here so people can grab ownership. won't duplicate the full doc.

sam: action: autoscaler tuning (reduce scale-down aggressiveness + add burst window). owner: sam. due: 2024-05-25. I'll open a draft PR tomorrow.

tara: action: throttling rule to stop retry storms (limit retries per client id). owner: tara. due: 2024-05-22. I'll post the rollout plan in eng-sre.

john: action: observability — token-level latency alert and a dashboard for queue depth. owner: john. due: 2024-05-24. putting initial alert + grafana link shortly.

miguel: action: post-deploy canary for models >1B tokens. ticket RW-1123 created, owner: miguel, due: 2024-06-01.

ops-bot: Incident RW-2024-05-18-SERVE closed. RCA published by elaine. Follow-up checkpoint scheduled: 2024-05-22 17:00 UTC.

elaine: Follow-up checkpoint details: Thu 2024-05-22 17:00 UTC (45m) in #postmortems. Agenda: action-item status, blockers, confirm observability changes, canary plan. Please update this thread with short status before the checkpoint.

sam: quick note — proposed autoscaler change (config snippet) below, will include tests in PR:
```yaml
scaleDownAggressiveness: 0.2
burstWindowSeconds: 30
maxScalePerMin: 6
```

tara: ack, will coordinate rollout window with eng-platform to avoid overlapping deploys.

john: alert PR https://git.redwood.internal/alerts/342 opened, will link dashboard once merged.

miguel: added the canary spec to RW-1123 — simple traffic split + latency guard.

elaine: thanks everyone. If you can't make the 5/22 checkpoint, post a short update here beforehand. We'll track completion in the RCA doc. :thumbsup:
